title: CLI commit help omits PowerPoint support
reasoning: The commit command is the user-facing CLI entry for snapshotting documents, but its help text says only .docx and .xlsx are accepted. The same CLI already handles slide diffs/show output, and the public API exports PowerPoint parsing through parsePptx/parseDocument, so the CLI contract presented to users is narrower than the implemented surface.
recommendation: Update the commit argument/help text to include .pptx or use SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS to keep the help synchronized with parser support.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests cover parsers, diffing, and SnapshotStore behavior, but they do not assert CLI help text or exercise the commit command with a .pptx fixture.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CLI smoke test that runs the commit help and checks that .pptx/PowerPoint appears, and ideally commits a minimal .pptx fixture using a temporary DOCGIT_DIR.
minimumFixScope: packages/core/src/cli.ts help text, plus a focused CLI smoke test.
